execution: require oracle.initial_state to contain exactly one value for every state_tuple_fields entry, then materialize those values into the closed nested state object
deep-copy the materialized oracle.initial_state into current_state
for each oracle.actions item in array order, select the one action rule with an exact label
resolve every argument only in the trusted registry named by the rule
evaluate guards in array order and stop at the first false guard
on guard failure, apply that guard's failure_effect and emit its disposition
when every guard is true, apply success_effect and emit success_disposition
emit a deep copy of the complete current_state as pre_state and the complete resulting state as post_state
replace current_state with a deep copy of post_state
reject unknown labels, argument count mismatch, unknown trusted references, arithmetic overflow, missing state fields, or non-domain values as an internal planning error

operand_and_resolution_language.state_operand: a string beginning state. resolves the exact closed-state path after that prefix
operand_and_resolution_language.argument_operand: a string equal to one action argument name resolves that argument's literal value
operand_and_resolution_language.bound_record_operand: a string beginning with a record_resolution binding name resolves that record or its exact dotted field
operand_and_resolution_language.literal_operand: any other scalar, null, boolean or array is used as its literal JSON value
operand_and_resolution_language.record_pair: [registry-name,key-expression] performs exact ID equality lookup after resolving key-expression and requires exactly one record
operand_and_resolution_language.unique-eq: [unique-eq,field,key-expression] selects exactly one registry record whose field equals the resolved key-expression; zero or multiple matches are an internal planning error
operand_and_resolution_language.required_only_when: skip the record lookup unless its guard tuple is true; a skipped binding resolves to null
operand_and_resolution_language.effect_tuple: [set,state-path,value-operand] applies the defined set primitive after resolving value-operand
operand_and_resolution_language.effect_string: a string effect must exactly name one effect_primitives member

guard_operators.eq: true iff left and right are equal JSON values
guard_operators.in: true iff left equals one member of the literal right array
guard_operators.lt: checked mathematical integer comparison left < right
guard_operators.lte: checked mathematical integer comparison left <= right
guard_operators.gt: checked mathematical integer comparison left > right
guard_operators.is-null: true iff the selected value is JSON null
guard_operators.trusted-ref-exists: true iff the argument ID exists in the rule's named trusted registry
guard_operators.duration-within-effective-ceiling: after start <= end, checked_sub(end,start) <= min(profile ceiling,publisher ceiling)
guard_operators.matches-active-session: trusted record publisher, session, live subject, actual public key and key ID all equal state.session
guard_operators.matches-high-water: when high_water.status is available, epoch equals high-water, sequence is greater, and start is at least latest_freeze_end; authority contract and protected source must equal high-water for an unchanged profile, but may change for a changed registered profile only when the trusted profile names the new pair and both trusted continuity fields are intact; when high-water is absent, true; otherwise false
guard_operators.recoverable: true iff high-water is available, or unavailable and exactly one trusted recovery is intact, names the unavailable component, carries a complete available temporal state equal to retained high-water values, and names the action's fresh challenge
guard_operators.policy-not-weakened: true iff trusted profile policy_strength is equal to or stronger than state.profile.policy_strength
guard_operators.different-new-session: true when predecessor_session_id is null; otherwise true iff new session ID, actual public key, key ID and trusted authority epoch are each unequal to the trusted predecessor values

effect_primitives.identity: return a deep copy of pre_state without mutation
effect_primitives.set: replace exactly one existing state path with the supplied literal or resolved trusted value
effect_primitives.clear-collection: replace state.collection with empty_values.collection and set ordering.active_collection_ref to null
effect_primitives.clear-evidence: replace state.evidence with empty_values.evidence and set ordering.in_flight_observation_ref to null
effect_primitives.load-challenge: copy every trusted challenge field into state.challenge, set status authenticated, and set consumed false
effect_primitives.open-collection: copy every trusted authority collection field into state.collection, set status open and observation_ref null, then set ordering.active_collection_ref
effect_primitives.freeze-observation: set collection status frozen and observation_ref; set proof and coverage pending; copy trusted authority statement state
effect_primitives.submit-observation: set challenge receipt and consumed=true; set proof covered; copy coverage and authority-statement states from the resolved trusted observation; set submitted observation, submission receipt and in-flight observation
effect_primitives.advance-high-water: copy authority contract, protected source, epoch, sequence and freeze end from collection; set status available; increment compare_generation by checked addition; clear in-flight; set retention retained
effect_primitives.restore-high-water: copy every high-water field from the one matching trusted recovery temporal_state and set status available
effect_primitives.restore-high-water-if-needed: apply restore-high-water exactly when pre_state.high_water.status is unavailable; otherwise apply identity
effect_primitives.terminal-loss: set session.status lost and session.continuity lost; clear challenge, collection and evidence; replace high_water with empty_values.high_water_deleted; set retention temporal_state deleted and deletion_required false
effect_primitives.concurrent-first-wins-then-loss: validate and advance the first observation atomically, then observe the second against the incremented compare_generation and apply terminal-loss
effect_primitives.delete-high-water: replace high_water with empty_values.high_water_deleted; set retention temporal_state deleted and deletion_required false

output.final_state: last post_state or initial_state when actions is empty

transform_interpreter.copy_rule: deep-copy only the selected baseline candidate before applying the transform
transform_interpreter.path_rule: path is an RFC-6901-style absolute pointer and must start with /candidate/; ~0 decodes to ~ and ~1 decodes to /; array components are canonical non-negative decimal indexes
transform_interpreter.replace: require path to exist and equal old by exact JSON equality, require value to differ from old, then perform exactly one replacement
transform_interpreter.remove: require path to exist and equal old by exact JSON equality, then remove exactly that object member or array element
transform_interpreter.insert: require path to name an existing array and index to be between zero and its length inclusive, then insert exactly one deep copy of value at index
postconditions: the resulting candidate differs from the baseline candidate
no candidate reference is resolved from oracle data
